data.summary: The datahub directory contains infrastructure, scripts, and configuration files for running DataHub quickstart instances, metadata ingestion, and catalog refreshing using Docker and Docker Compose.

file_insights.name: dh.sh
file_insights.summary: Bash script to manage DataHub Docker Compose lifecycle.
file_insights.source_summary: Runs docker-compose with specific config files and environment parameters.
file_insights.detailed_description: A bash wrapper script for managing the DataHub Docker Compose project, simplifying commands like up, down, ps, logs, and pull.

file_insights.name: docker-compose.quickstart.yml
file_insights.summary: Docker compose configuration for DataHub quickstart stack.
file_insights.source_summary: Defines Docker services for datahub-actions-quickstart, gms, frontend, kafka, mysql, and opensearch.
file_insights.detailed_description: Docker Compose file defining services for the DataHub quickstart stack including GMS, frontend, kafka, mysql, and opensearch.
responsibilities: Configure container health checks and dependencies

file_insights.name: ingest.sh
file_insights.summary: Bash script for running DataHub metadata ingestion.
file_insights.source_summary: Executes acryldata/datahub-ingestion container using host network and mounted recipe files.
file_insights.detailed_description: Bash script to run the DataHub ingestion container on the host network, executing recipes for iceberg, dbt, or dbt_semantic.
responsibilities: Mount local recipes and dbt targets into container

file_insights.name: refresh.sh
file_insights.summary: Bash script to refresh data catalog and verify PII columns.
file_insights.source_summary: Refreshes catalog from warehouse and dbt projects, ensuring PII compliance.
file_insights.detailed_description: Bash script to refresh the catalog from warehouse and dbt project, validating PII columns.

file_insights.name: restart.override.yml
file_insights.summary: Docker compose override for service restart policies.
file_insights.source_summary: Sets restart policy to unless-stopped for key DataHub containers.
file_insights.detailed_description: Docker Compose override file ensuring all long-running DataHub services restart unless explicitly stopped.
responsibilities: Configure restart policy for DataHub services
